"Summit Software maintains a strong liquidity position with **$1.5M in cash reserves**. Furthermore, our robust top-line performance—highlighted by **$4.0M in revenue last quarter**—demonstrates strong market traction and underscores our sustainable growth trajectory. Our current cash position and revenue generation capabilities ensure we are well-capitalized to execute our upcoming initiatives."

***
